## Interactive lectures

[**Module 09: Regression — open the presentation**](regression.html)

Explore least squares, coefficient uncertainty, weighting, regularization, and nonlinear regression with editable Python examples.

- Open the slides in a current desktop browser. Allow Python and its packages to finish loading.
- Use the arrow controls to move between slides and **Esc** for the slide overview.
- Click inside a code block to edit, then select **Run Code**. Select **Start Over** to restore the supplied code.
- Each browser has an independent Python session. Your changes do not change the course materials.
- The examples use synthetic data. No account or Python installation is required.

[Course notebooks](https://github.com/jinwar/GeophysicsComputing_GPGN436536) · [Presentation source](https://github.com/jinwar/GeophysicsComputing_Interactive_Slides)
